packageRules.description: The A2UI release train: `androidx.a2ui`, `androidx.a2ui.compose` and `material3-a2ui` are cut together and a skewed pair fails at runtime, when a catalog built against one engine meets another's processor. One PR, never automerged: the sticker sheet and a2ui-basic-catalog.schema.json are the review.
The AndroidX Compose line is pinned to exactly what material3-a2ui's POM names; it moves when the A2UI train does, not on its own.
compose-ai-tools' Gradle plugin and the reusable workflows are one release.
